questions.question: What is the specified idle-speed range for the 6.2-liter engine in the Engine Lubrication Tests?
What is the specified idle-speed range for the 6.2-liter engine in the Engine Lubrication Tests?
What is the specified idle-speed range for the 6.2-liter engine in the HMMWV Engine Lubrication Tests?

claims.text: The specified idle-speed range for the 6.2-liter engine in the Engine Lubrication Tests is 600 to 700 RPM.

The specified idle-speed range for the 6.2-liter engine in the Engine Lubrication Tests is based on standard maintenance and operational guidelines for the HMMWV (M998-series) outlined in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1 (1996, including Change 2 dated 2004).
